gaps.sentence: He was accused ___ stealing the confidential documents.
gaps.explanation: 'Accuse somebody of doing something' — the preposition is fixed.

gaps.sentence: I'd rather you ___ smoke in here.
She made the cake ___, without any help at all.
gaps.explanation: 'She made it herself' — the reflexive stresses she did it alone.

gaps.sentence: She was ___ the impression that the interview was today.
gaps.explanation: 'Under the impression that …' = believing, perhaps wrongly.

gaps.sentence: By this time tomorrow, we ___ have finished the whole report.
gaps.explanation: 'By + future time' calls for the future perfect: will have finished.

gaps.sentence: We had the walls ___ last month.
gaps.explanation: 'have something done' = arrange for it to be done: had the walls painted.

gaps.sentence: She's the most generous person I've ___ met.
gaps.explanation: 'the best… I've ever seen/met' — 'ever' with superlatives.
